construction: Preserve centered target activation PCA span at 99.99% energy and the exact LayerNorm affine-null direction. Add normalized public-anchor rows projected into the remaining complement, with a fixed half-width swap of anchor identities. Derive each amplitude once from the strict rowwise cosine preference inequalities of original AGA; retain only feasible complete swap cycles. Compensate bias at the target calibration mean. No gradient, response reconstruction, amplitude/rank scan, target labels or future partner access.
controls: Unprotected expert and same-amplitude coherent anchor-identity complement edits. Each receives direct merging and unchanged author AGA on all 12 target layers. Public c_fc weight/bias reset is evaluated afterward; its state is exactly shared among all three presets. Native MNIST and MNIST/SVHN merged accuracies are full official-test measurements.
limits: PCA tails are approximate low-variance directions, not true task-null directions. Exact span preservation is local and does not guarantee utility after downstream propagation, harmful merging, or resistance to alternative matching/cleanup. This is a targeted solver-mechanism probe, not established novelty or broad adaptive protection. Three local layers chosen from the existing target-only profile. Eight experts participate but two tasks are evaluated; no eight-task mean or exact Table 6 reproduction claim. Prior test evidence has been inspected during this project; this is not an unseen research-data claim.
calibration: New deterministic training indices exclude the listed earlier calibration/confirmation indices and the task-profile MNIST exclusion list. 256 construction images plus disjoint 256 confirmation images. Confirmation and test results cannot change this candidate. Release edits and fingerprints are saved before partner loading.
